notes.title: Stability Patch
notes.content: Just some engine updates to increase compatibility with old graphics cards.

notes.title: Major Update 1.8
notes.content:
[h2]Major Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Colored Arrows - choose from 15 different arrow colors!
[*] Ambience Overhaul - massively optimizes the ambience system to take over 90% less resources, adds several more sounds, and re-balances the levels and effects for a more consistent and pleasing experience!
[*] Environment Overhaul - things like trees, grass, and water, now render more efficiently and look better!
[*] Core Engine Upgrades - adds engine performance improvements from Floppy Cat Adventures
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improves cat walking animation
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixes rare crash on corrupt replay
[*] Fixes culling of inaudible sounds
[*] Removes laggy parallax corner case
[*] Fixes over saturated reverb on menu sounds
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update 1.7
notes.content:
[h2]Major Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sand Mountain - new very hard map!
[*] Soft Tree Leaves - no more dying from falling into a soft little leaf, they also now blow in the wind!
[*] Script Hooks - multiple scripts (mods) can now subscribe to the same game events through script hooks.
[*] Items like targets can now be scaled to any size you want.
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bow pullback speed is slightly faster for more responsive feel.
[*] Pregame no longer applies in single player, it now purely represents a server that is open for more players to join. Once pregame is over, no new players can join until the next round.
[*] Objects now fade between level of detail levels rather than abruptly snap.
[*] Improved Black Hole graphics.
[*] Added god rays.
[*] Improved water waves generation.
[*] Improved sound quality.
[*] Improved ambience generation.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized loading speed.
[*] Fixed gaps in collision model of the target.
[*] Fixed physics slowdown when too many sounds are active.
[*] Fixed water reflections.
[*] Fixed wrong camera angle for fur selection.
[*] Fixed transparency issue with snowy trees.
[*] Reduced Z-Fighting and shadow acne.
[*] Improved frame timing and replay consistency.
[*] Fixed sliders moving weird.
[*] Fixed many bad parallax spots.
[*] Fixed rare issue where the bow would un-equip.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
This is a big one!

Fixes several bugs:
[list]
[*] Menus were sometimes not disappearing correctly
[*] Editor could crash when changing models or materials
[*] Server will no longer 'forget' players when moving to next map
[*] Resetting the map wasn't clearing all flags for targets leading to weird behavior in 1-hole maps
[*] No more nonsense colors underwater 
[*] Fixes controller button icon alignment
[/list]

New Features!
[list]
[*] New Black Hole vortex with warpy gravity and warpy visuals
[*] Adds a pregame 'readyup' phase, shoot around while you wait for players to join without ruining your score. After you(and anyone else in the server if you're online) ready up, everyone gets reset to the start of the map and you're off to shooting for real!
[*] Run Timer: After ready-ups, the run timer will start ticking, showing you how quickly you're beating the course!
[*] Save your replays! After completing a map, you now have the option to save a replay of your run! There's 3 settings for quality, I recommend full quality of course, but if you have limited ram or drive space there's the lower options. Approx ram usage/file size per minute: low - .5mb, med - 2mb, high - 8mb
[*] Brightness slider to adjust global gamma to you taste/monitor
[*] Improved bloom and blur effects
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
This update improves a lot of the game's netcode to be more reliable, adds a few small features, and fixes several small bugs.

[list]
[*] Promoted many network messages to TCP to reliably ensure players don't desync due to network instability
[*] Splash effect improved and now triggers correctly
[*] Adds gravity wells
[*] Improved responsiveness of entering the editor
[*] Prevents "pre-cancel"  (If you've ever had the bow shoot and immediately retract, it won't do that anymore)
[*] Fixes imperceptible animation bug
[*] Fixes issues with map vote UI sticking around too long
[/list]

Thanks!

Here's the future roadmap by the way:
[olist]
[*] Speedrun timer
[*] Replay save and view
[*] More maps
[*] Steam workshop
[*] Mods
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Adds a number of bug fixes and quality of life improvements such as:

[list]
[*] Menus and buttons and more responsive
[*] Dynamic menu loading no longer can hang the game
[*] Added confirmation to quitting the game
[*] Fixed bug where bow pulling sounds sometimes wouldn't happen
[*] Fixed issue where ambient sounds sometimes would not stop playing
[*] Adds loading tips and loading status display
[*] Improved scrolling for course select menus
[*] Improved menu look and feel
[*] Adds display options menu
[*] Adds graphics settings to toggle post processing effects
[*] Increased the strength and quality of Depth of Field Blur and Bloom
[*] Cleans up dynamic texture loading
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Player Customization Menu:
Now you can set your own personal style by choosing a fur color and an eye color!

Text Chat:
Text chat now works properly when playing multiplayer! Look out for the speech bubbles!

Also changes some internals to prevent a rare bug where the game could hang after finishing a map or clicking a button.

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Adds proper dialogue avatar for Kukoh and fixes many small bugs including:
[list]
[*] Impact sounds have a more reasonable maximum volume
[*] "Join Friends" menu now correctly disappears after you join a game
[*] Menu slider detail text is now shown properly
[*] Multiplayer menu formatting fixed
[*] Fixed issue where the server wouldn't receive nicknames
[*] Game window now remembers it's desktop position properly
[*] UI now resizes correctly when leaving fullscreen mode
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Changes:
Overall better font readability
Maps are tagged by difficulty.
Save Map UI now lets you choose an icon and a difficulty tag.
Renamed "Promote Moderator" menu to "Player Permissions".
Fixed a bug where promoting a player to moderator would kick them from the server.
Fixed a bug where promotion menu didn't update immediately.
Added finer granularity to player permissions by adding 'editor' role where the player can edit the map but not kick other players.
